description: Follow-up from the 0.4.1 scanned-paper fix (journal 2026-09-28-scanned-paper-blank-indirect-contents.md). On a 12-page Acrobat Capture CCITT scan, per-page dark-pixel count (<128) vs poppler pdftoppm: ~13% MORE dark at 72 dpi, ~15-20% LESS at 150 dpi -- the 1-bpc image resampling filter differs from poppler/MuPDF (fz_subsample_pixmap + smooth scaling). Readable, not a correctness blocker. Also kpdf-doctor --render reports '5-7% of the page is solid black -- suspect an image drawn without its /SMask' on every dense page of such scans: false positive for 1-bit text scans (no SMask involved). Check MuPDF draw-scale-simple.c / fz_subsample_pixmap for the reference behaviour before changing.
title: kopitiam-pdf: 1-bpc scan images downscale differently from poppler; kpdf-doctor solid-black check false-positive on 1-bit text scans
